sections.title: A perspective shaped by experience
paragraphs: Chun-Hao Li is a professor in the Department of Social and Policy Sciences and Dean of Yuan Ze University’s College of Humanities and Social Sciences. He is listed among the faculty associated with IBSC.
His expertise covers population research, including historical population studies, and urban studies. He earned graduate degrees in Sociology and Urban Affairs at Michigan State University.

His research includes family and migration in Taiwan, historical household records, and the experiences and well-being of immigrants. He is also affiliated with Academia Sinica’s Institute of Ethnology as an adjunct research fellow.
